comment: The browsers the integration tests are pinned to. flake.nix reads this file, asserts that its nixpkgs revision provides exactly these, and its dev shell names them in STRIDER_CHROMIUM, STRIDER_FIREFOX, STRIDER_WEBKIT and STRIDER_WEBKITGTK. The fixtures are the drift test's recordings of each (test/fixtures/traffic/). Moving a pin means moving nixpkgs (flake.lock), recording the fixtures again, and re-checking the error tables' evidence.
